title: חַד
content: [Str259] † חַד adj. one, a;—ms ´ח: Dn 2:31+; fs.חֲדָה Ezr 4:8 +;—1. one side Dn 7:5; n. om. 6:3; חֲדָה 2:9 = one and invariable (inevitable) ; כַּחֲדָה v:35 as one, altogether (so S-CK 3 Targum, and late BH כְּאֶחָד Ezr 2:64 +); = ordinal, שְׁנַת חֲדָה first year 7:1, Ezr 5:13, 6:3; ´ח: = a certain one (τινὰ) Dn 7:16 (c. מִן partit.). 2. a (indef. art.) c. subst. Dn 2:31, 6:18, 4:16 (v. שָׁעָה), Ezr 4:8, 6:2, חַד שִׁדְעָךְ Dn 3:19 = seven-fold (as Syr.: Nö§ 241 PS 1194; cf. Ex 16:5 Syrver), v. K§ 66, 2.

title: חֲבַל
content: [Str2255,2254] † [חֲבַל] vb. Pa. destroy, hurt (v. BH II, חבל);—Pf. 3 mpl. sf. חַבְּלוּנִי Dn 6:23 (of lions); Imv. mpl. sf. חַבְּלוּהִי 4:20 (sf. of tree); Inf. לְחַבָּלָה Ezr 6:12 (acc. of temple). Hithpa. be destroyed: Impf. 3 fs. תִּתְחַבַּל Dn 2:44, 6:27, 7:14 (בַָּל-; all of kingdom of God).

title: חֲבָל
content: [Str2257] † חֲבָל n.m.:Dn 6:24 hurt, injury;—abs. ´ח: Dn 3:25, 6:24, cf. REvS362 A 2; emph. חֲבָלָא Ezr 4:22.

title: חֲבוּלָא
content: [Str2248] † חֲבוּלָא n.f. hurtful act, crime;—abs. ´ח: Dn 6:23.

title: חֲבַר
content:
[Str2269,2266] † [חֲבַר] n.m. fellow, comrade (Targum Syr.; v. BH);—pl. sf. חַבְרוֺ֫הִי Dn 2:13, 2:17, 2:18.

[Str2273] † [חַבְרָה] n.f. fellow;—pl. sf. חַבְרָתַָהּ Dn 7:20 its fellows (in vision of horns).

[Str2292] † חַגַּי n.pr.m prophet (BH id.);—Ezr 5:1, 6:14.

[Str2298] חַד, חֲדָה v. אחד

[Str2304–05] † חֶדְוָה n.f. joy (Targum Syr.; v. BH II. תדה);—abs. ´נְּח: Ezr 6:16 with joy.

[Str2306,2373] † [חֲדִי], or (K§ 65, 6 a)) חַד] n.m. breast (Targum Syr.; v. BH II. חחה);—du. (SchulthZAW xxii (1902), 164) sf. חֲדוֺ֫הִי Dn 2:32.

[Str2319,2323] † חֲדַָת adj. new (Targum Syr.; BH חדשׁ);—´ח: Ezr 6:4.

title: חוד
content:
חוד (√ of following; Targum חוּד, חוּדִיתָא, riddle, v. BH and K§ 57 b) a)).

[Str280] † [אֲחִידָה] n.f. riddle;—fpl. abs. אֲחִידָן Dn 5:12.

title: חֲוָה
content:
[Str2324,2331] † [חֲוָה] vb. Pa. Haph. (M.:§ 65 c) declare (Targum Syr.; BH III. [חָוָה] (late));—Pa. c. acc. פִּשְׁרָא (or equiv.): Impf. 3 ms. sf. יְחַוִּנַּ֫נִי (sf. Pers. Indir. obj.) Dn 5:7, יְּחֵוִנֵּהּ 2:11 (קֳדָּם Pers.); 1 s. אֲחַוֶה 2:24 (ל pers), 1 pl. אְחַוֶּה v:4. Haph. usu. c. acc. פִשְׁרָא (or equiv.): Impf. 3 ms. יְהַחֲוֶה Dn 5:12; 2 mpl. תְּהַחֲוֺן 2:6, sf. (of indir. obj.) תְחַחֲוֻ֫נַּנִי v:9; 1 pl. נְהַחֲוֶה v:7; Imv. mpl. sf. (of indir. obj.) הַחֲוָֺנִי v:6; Inf. לְהַחֲוָיָה v:10, 5:15; + ל Pers. 2:16, 2:27; c. acc. of signs and wonders 3:32.

[Str263] † [אַחֲוָיָה] n.f. a declaring (prop. Inf. Aph., K§ 60. 1));—cstr. אַחֲוָיַת אֲחִידָן Dn 5:12 the declaring of riddles (cf. לְהַגִּיד הַחִרדָה Ju 14:14 f., Bev).

title: חוּט
content: [Str2338] † [חוּט or חִיט] vb. repair (foundations);—Hilph. Impf. 3 mpl. יַחִ֫יטוּ Ezr 4:12 (si vera 1. [NöGGA. Nö1884, 1018 Str:§ 13 b]), rare from for יְהִיטוּן K§§ 16, 5. 26. 1 M§ 63 g. Anm., but perh. read this, and regard as Qal (orig. meaning dub.; Ar. خَاطَ is sew, = Targum חוּט, Syr. ܚܛ, cf. BH חוּט thread; Syr. Pa. Also join together (so here SchulthZAW Schulthxxii (1902). Schulth162 Anm.), cf. Ar. خَيّط conjunxit trabes (de GoejeBibl. Geogr. Arab., Pt. iv (1879), Gloss. 231: cf. Pt. viii (1894), Gloss. P. xx); FräZAW xix (1899), 180 conj. pull down and clear away (for rebuilding), cf. ḫaiṭu D1WB 274; JenKB vi. 344 cp. As. ḫâṭu, observe, learn D1WB I. היט), i.e. examine, test; HptGu. Ezr-Ne 62 conj. √ חטט excauate, cf. Ar. اختطّ secure site by a mark, found a town; StrGr (1905) 40 יְהִיבוּ (after Seybold), cf. Ezr 5:16; al. conj. build wall, denom., cf. Ar. حَايءِطُم wall (√ حوط guard, surround)).

title: חִוָּר
content: [Str2357–58] † חִוָּר adj. white (Targum Syr.; BH I. [חָוַר]);—Dn 7:9 (robe).

title: חֲזָה
content:
[Str2370,2372] † חֲזָה vb. see, behold (v. BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´ח: Dn 4:20, 5:1; 2 ms. תֲוַיְתָ 2:43 +, תָה- 2:41, 2:41; 1 S. חֲזֵית v:46 +; 2 mpl. תֲוֵיתוּן 2:8; Pe. Inf. מְֶָחֱזֵ+זא Ezr 4:14; Pt. act. חָוֵה Dn 2:31 + 14 t.; pl. חָוַיִן 3:27, 5:23; pass/ חֲוֵה 3:19;—1. see, have sense: of sight Dn 5:23. 2. see, behold: a. acc. Pers. 3:25, c. ל v:27, acc. rei 5:5. b. see, witness dishonour of king (acc.) Ezr 4:14. 3. usu. behold in dream or vision (oft. pt. in periphrast. conj.), acc. Pers., 4:20, acc. rei 2:41, 2:41, 2:43, 4:17, abs. 2:34, 7:4, 7:7, 7:9, 7:11, 7:11, 7:21, + אֲלוּ 2:31, 4:7, 4:10, אֲרוּ 7:2, 7:6, 7:13; c. obj. cl. 2:8, 2:45; behold a dream, acc. חֵלֶם, 2:26, 4:2, 4:6, 4:15, 7:1. 4. pass.= customary (seemly) Dn 3:19 (so Targum Lv 5:10 al., v. Dr).

[Str2376] † [חְֶזוּ] n.m. vision, appearance;—emph. חֶוְוָא (K§ 55, 6 b)) Dn 2:19; sf. וִי- 7:2, וִהּ- v:20; pl. cstr. חֶזְוֵי 2:28 +;—1. vision (as mode of revelation) 2:19 (דִּי לֵילְיָא ´ח:), 7:2, so 7:7. 7:13, רֵישָׁא ´ח: 2:28, 4:2, 4:7, 4:10, 7:1, 7:15, חֶלְמָא ´ח: 4:6 (GieGGA, 1895, 598 reads אֲחַוֵּא I will relate). 2. appearance 7:20.

[Str2379] † [חֲזוֺת K§ 55, 6 b)2; rd. perh. וּת- K§ xxii (1902). 165 f.);—sf. חֲווֺהֵתּ Dn 4:8. 17.

title: חֲטָי
content:
[Str2399,2408] † [חֲטָי] n.[m.] sin (v. BH חטא);—sf. חֲטָיָךָ Dn 4:24 (Qr חֲטָאָךָ K§ 57 a) β)), < pl. (for חַטְיָיךָ) Hi Bev Kmp Behrm, cf. ‖עַוַיָתָ.

[Str2403,2409] † חַטָּיָא n.f. sin-offering (BH חַטָּאת 4; Nab. חטיאת penalty, acc. to SAC51);—abs. ´ת: Ezr 6:17 Kt, Qr הַטָּאָה.

title: חֲיָא
content:
[Str2418,2421] † [חֲיָא] vb. live (v. BH תָיָה);—Pe. Imv. לְעָֽלְמִין חֱיִי live for ever! Dn 2:4, 3:9, 5:10, 6:7, 6:22. Hiph. Pt. מַחֵא (K§ 11, 3 b) γ) HptKmp. Dn. 28) Dn 5:19 let live.

[Str2416–17] † חַי adj. living (BH id);—1. of God: abs. ´ח: Dn 4:31, emph. חַיָא 6:21, 6:27; men, pl. emph. חַיַיָא the lilving 2:30, 4:14. 2. pl. as n. abstr. life (BH חַיִּים): חַיִּין 7:12; cstr. חַיֵּי Ezr 6:10.

[Str2416,2423] † חֵיוָא, חֵיוָה n.f. beast (BH II. חַיָה);—abs. אָ֯ Dn 4:13, הָ֯ 7:5, 7:7; emph. חֵיוְתָא 7:6, 7:11, 7:19, 7:23, and (coll.) 4:11, 4:12, 5:21; cstr. (coll.) חֵיוַת בָּרָא 2:38, 4:9, 4:18, 4:20, 4:22, 4:29; pl. abs. חֵיוָן 7:3, emph. חֵיוָתָא 7:7, 7:12, 7:17.

[Str2428,2429]1093 † חַ֫יִל n.m. power, strength, army (v. BH II. חול, חיל);—1. power: abs. בְּאֶדְרָע וְחָיִל Ezr 4:23 by force and power; ´קרא בְח: i.e. call loudly Dn 3:4, בְּחַיִל 4:11, 5:7; ´גִּבָּרֵיאח: 3:20 mighty men of power. 2. force, army, sf. חֵילֵהּ 3:20; cstr. חֵיל שְׁמַיָּא 4:32 (= BH צְכָא הַשָּׁמַיִם).

title: חַכִּים
content:
[Str2445,2450] [חַכִּים]:14 n.m. wise man (v. BH חכם);—pl. abs. חַכִּימִין Dn 2:21; elsewhere of the class possessed of occult learning in Bab. v:27, emph. מַיָא- v:13, 5:15; cstr. מֵי- 2:12, 2:14 + 7 t. Dn.

[Str2452] † חָכְמָה n.f. wisdom;—´ח: abs. Dn 2:30 +, emph. תָכְמְתָא Dn 2:20 +, cstr. חָכְמַת 5:11, Ezr 7:25;—wisdom, attrib. of God Dn 2:20; of gods 5:11; of man 2:30; of God imparted to man Ezr 7:25 (practical wisdom), Dn 2:21; = occult knowledge (v. foregoing) imparted to men v:23, 5:11, 5:14.

[Str2493,2472] תֵלֶם:22 n.m.:Dn 4:2 dream (Targum Syr.; v. BH חֲלוֺם, √ II. חלם);—abs. ´ח: Dn 4:2, 7:1; emph. חֶלְמָא 2:4 +; sf. חֶלְמִי 4:6, מָךְ- 2:28; pl. חֶלְמִין 5:12;—dream, as vehicle of revelation Dn 2:4 + 10 t., 4:3 + 6 t., 5:12; to prophet 7:1.

title: חֲלַף
content:
[Str2498–99] † [חֲלַף] vb. pass (over) (v. BH);—Pe. c. יַל Pers. pass over one (of time): Impf. 3 mpl. יִחְלְפוּן Dn 4:13, 4:20, 4:22, 4:29.

[Str2508,2505] † חֲלָק n.[m.] portion, possession, lot (v. BH);—abs. ´ח: possession in land Ezr 4:16; sf. חֲלְקֵהּ Dn 4:12. 4:20, i.e. his appointed lot.

[Str4255,4256] † [מַחְלְקָה] n.f. class, division, of priests and Levites (BH מַחְלֽקֶת);—pl. sf. מַחְלְקָֽהְתוֺן Ezr 6:18.

[Str2528] חֲמָר v. יחוּ p. 1095

[Str2561–62] † חֲמַר n.m. wine (Targum Syr.; BH חֶמֶר (poet. and late), √ I. חמר);—abs. ´ח: Ezr 6:9, 7:22; emph. חַמָרָא Dn 5:1, 5:2, 5:4, 5:23.

[Str2406,2591] † [חִנְטָה] n.f. wheat (v. BH חִטָּה, √ חָנַט; NöLCB. Nö1896. Nö703 cp. Eg. chnt; OAram. has חטה, pl. חטי, Palm. חטא Lzb279 SAC51);—pl. חִנְטִין Ezr 6:9, 7:22.

[Str2597–98] † [חֲנֻכָּה] n.f. dedication (Targum; BH id., √ חנך);—cstr. חֲנֻכַּת, of image Dn 3:2, 3:3; temple Ezr 6:16, 6:17.

title: חֲנַן
content:
[Str2603–04] † [חֲנַן] vb. shew favour (v. BH);—Pa. Inf. c. aff. Pers. מִחַן (K§ 46, 3 a) Dn 4:24 (cf. BH Pō‘. Pr 14:21). Hithpa. implore favour (of God; so BH Hithp.), Pt. מִתְחַנֵּן Dn 6:12.

[Str2608] † חֲנַנְיָה n.pr.m (= BH id. 5.);—Dn 2:17.

title: חֲסֵן
content:
[Str2631,2630] † [חֲסֵן] vb. Haph. take … possession of (Syr. be strong, overcome; Targum be strong, take possession of; Eg. Aram. Haph. חחסן hold property S-CD 2+, cf. BH חסן);—Pf. 3 mpl. הֶחֱסִ֫נ (K§ 38. 3 Kmpad loc.) Dn 7:22; Impf. 3 mpl. יַחְסְנוּן (K§ 38. 1 b)) v:18 (perhaps point סִנוּן-).

[Str2632] † [חֵ֫סֶן] n.m. (royal) power;—emph. חִסְנָא Dn 2:37; sf. חִסְנִי 4:27.

[Str2635,2636] † חֲסַף n.[m.] clay, potsherd (Targumid.; Chr-Pal. ܚܣܦܐ clay vessel, ܚܨܒܢܐ pl. potsherds Schulth68, Syr. ܚܨܦܐ potsherd; Targumחצְבָא, NH חָצָב clay vessel; As ḫaṣbu, id., ܚܙܒܐ jar (PS1238), whence Ar. خَزَفَ pottery Frä169, but Sab. חסף jar, acc to HomZMG Homxivi (1892), 532; cf. Eth. ፀሕብ፡ jar (transp.; DI1265); v.BH [חַסְפַּם]);—´ח: abs. Dn 2:41 (דִּי פֶּצָר ´ח:), חֲסַָף v:33, v:42; cstr. טִינָא ´ח: v:41, v:43; emph. חַסְפָּא v:34, v:35, v:43, v:45.

[Str2627] † חַסִּר adj. lacking, wanting, deficient (cf. BH חָסֵר);—´ח: Dn 5:27.

title: חֲצַף
content: [Str2685] † חֲצַף vb. Haph. shew insolence, harshness (NH חצף Hiph. act insolently, so Targum Aph.; Syr. ܚܨܦ be audacious);—Pt. f. מַחְצְפָה (K§ 33, 2 e)) Dn 3:22 overbearing (of command), מְהַחְצְפָה 2:15 harsh (id.).

title: II חרב
content:
[Str2717–18] † vb. be waste (v. BH II. חרב);—Hoph. Pf. הָחָרְבַָת Ezr 4:15 city was laid waste.

[Str2748–49] ‡ † חַרְטֹם n.m. magician (BH i.d., √ I. חרט);—abs. Dn 2:10; pl. abs. חַרְטֻמִּין 2:27, 5:11; מַּיָא- 4:4, 4:6.

title: חֲרַךְ
content:
[Str2761,2504,2783] † [חֲרַךְ] vb. singe (Targum Syr.; NH חָרַח);—Hithpa. Pf. 3 ms. הִתְחָרַח Dn 3:27 (of hair).

[Str2504,2783] † [חֲרַץ] n.[m.] loin (v. BH חָלָץ, √ II. [חָלַץ]);—sf. חַרְצֵהּ Dn 5:6 the joints of his loin (v. קְטַר).

title: חֲשַׁב
content: [Str2803–04] † [חֲשַׁב] vb. think, account (v. BH);—Pe. Pt. pass pl. כְּלָה חֲשִׁיבִון Dn 4:32 l1 Ke those not accounted of, of no account, Bev Dr.

title: חֲשַׁח
content:
[Str2818] † [חֲשַׁח] vb. need (As. ḫašâḫu, crave; Syr. ܚܫܚ in need of; not Targum;—Pe. Pt. pl. חָֽשְׁחִין Dn 3:16, sg. Inf. (van d. H., wrongly, ´חַשׁ:).

[Str2818] † [חַשְׁחָה] n.f. thing needed (Syr. ܚܫܚܬܐ; Nö in Kp. 175);—pl. חַשְׁחָן Ezr 6:9.

[Str2819] † [חַשְׁחוּ] n.f. coll. things needed, requirement (Syr. id.);—cstr. חַשְׁתוּת בֵּית אֱלָהָח Ezr 7:20.

title: חשׁף
content:
[Str2822] חשׁף (v. BH חשֶׁךְ darkness, √ חשׁף).

[Str2816] † [חֲשׁוֺךְ] n.[m.] darkness;—emph. חֲשׁוֺכָא Dn 2:22.

title: חֲשַׁל
content: [Str2827] † [חֲשַׁל] vb. shatter by a blow (As. ḫašâlu, shatter, perhaps thresh; NH חָשַׁל Pi. shatter: J Aram. חֲשַׁל forge, hammer, Syr. ܚܫܰܠ forge, furbish; Buhl14 cp. Targum חוּשְׁלָא barley-groats (as pounded, beaten), and perh. As. ḫušlu, barley; NöM 135 cp. Ar. حَسَلَ thrust, drive away (Frey), Targum נַחְשׁוֺל storm (y sea; cf. in Eng. beaten, buffetted by waves; As. loan-word BaZA ii. 117), Syr. ܡܰܚܫܽܘܠ id.);—Pe. Pt. act. חָשֵׁל Dn 2:40 (acc. rei).

title: חֲתַם
content: [Str2856–57] † [חֲתַם] vb. seal (v. BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. sf. (of stone) חַתְמֶהּ Dn 6:18 (ב instr.).

title: חְֶמָא
content: [Str2528] † חְֶמָא n.f. rage;—abs. Dn 3:19, ´חֲ: v:13.
